description: ballSwivel 15 turns the whole foot about up through the toe pivot (4, 3.3, 1.8), the author's "squash a bug" (2026-11-25). The toe stays at the pivot and turns Rz 90 then Ry 15 about the world's axes (XYZ euler (15, 0, 90)). The toe tip, offset (0, -0.1, 0.6) from the toe, swings to (0.6 sin15, -0.1, 0.6 cos15), so (4.155291, 3.2, 2.379555), turned the same. The hand, offset (0, 0.7, -1.8), goes to (4 - 1.8 sin15, 4, 1.8 - 1.8 cos15) = (3.534126, 4, 0.061334).
